issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing init_world(width, height) to set the dimensions, but the template file helloWorld.asm does not provide an init_world stub. The solution repository does include an init_world label, however it only reads a single parameter (reads [esp+4], i.e. only width) and thus does not handle both width and height as described. This mismatch (problem expects two parameters, solution handles one, and template omits the function) can confuse students about the expected function signature and parameter handling.
issues.suggestedFix: Either add a clear init_world(width, height) stub to the template (e.g. a label init_world: with a TODO and the expected calling convention) or update the problem statement to match the actual implementation. Additionally, ensure the solution's init_world handles both parameters (e.g. read width from [esp+4] and height from [esp+8]) or document that only width is supported.
